question: Did Jesus perform many signs and wonders?
summary: John 3:2, John 12:37, John 20:30, and Acts 2:22 explicitly say Jesus performed many signs and miracles publicly. Mark 8:12 has Jesus refuse to give any sign at all: "there shall no sign be given unto this generation." Matthew 12:39 / 16:4 modifies the refusal slightly to allow one exception — "the sign of the prophet Jonas." Three positions sit in the same canon: many signs, no signs, and one sign.

reconcile.connective: Gill reads "no sign" as refusing only a sign from heaven, consistent with the many signs already shown and the coming sign of Jonah.

discrepancy.connective: The Skeptic's Annotated Bible presses this as a real contradiction: the blanket refusal, the "many signs," and Matthew's Jonah exception can't all be true.

pd_work.author: John Haley
pd_work.note: Haley treats Matt 16:4 against Mark 8:12 directly, under 'Doctrinal Discrepancies,' as a variant-quotation case: "May not Mark mean, there shall no future sign be given? The 'sign of the prophet Jonas' was taken from the records of the past. At all events, that kind of sign sought for by the Jews was peremptorily refused."

link.title: Is there a Bible contradiction in Mark 8:11-12?
link.note: Live apologetic treatment arguing Jesus refused the Pharisees' immediate demand for a legitimating sign while still performing many signs elsewhere, with the Jonah sign (his resurrection) reserved for later.

excerpts.attribution: John Gill, Exposition of the Entire Bible (1746-63)
excerpts.excerpt_text: why doth this generation seek after a sign? when so many have been shown among them, and they will not believe: verily I say unto you, there shall no sign be given to this generation: such as they desired; namely, one from heaven. The Evangelist Matthew adds, "but the sign of the Prophet Jonas" …
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Directly reconciles all three tension legs in one note: concedes many signs already shown, glosses the Mark refusal as refusal of a from-heaven sign specifically, and cites Matthew's added Jonah exception.
